(allow file-ioctl

(deny file-ioctl)

(enable-profile-flag "common-syscall-rules")
(enable-profile-flag "common-apple-internal-rules")
(enable-profile-flag "common-apple-signed-executable-rules")
(enable-profile-flag "common-mach-lookups")

(allow asr-parser-enter)

(allow coalition-info)

(allow consume-extension)

(allow darwin-notification-post)

(allow dynamic-code-generation)

(allow file-clone)

(allow file-graft)

(allow file-ioctl
	(require-all
		(uid 0)
		(vnode-type CHARACTER-DEVICE)
		(%entitlement-is-bool-true "com.apple.security.ts.bpf")
		(literal "/dev/bpf*")
	)
)
(allow file-ioctl
	(require-all
		(ioctl-command
			DKIOCGETBLOCKCOUNT
			DKIOCGETBLOCKSIZE
			DKIOCGETMAXBLOCKCOUNTWRITE
			DKIOCSYNCHRONIZE
			DKIOCUNMAP)
		(signing-identifier "com.apple.storagekitd")
	)
)
(allow file-ioctl
	(require-all
		(signing-identifier "com.apple.gpsd")
		(literal "/dev/cu.gps")
	)
)
(allow file-ioctl
	(require-all
		(literal "/dev/ttys*")
		(signing-identifier "com.apple.privacyaccountingctl")
		(regex #"^/dev/ttys([0-9])*")
	)
)
(allow file-ioctl
	(require-all
		(require-any
			(literal "/dev/bpf[0-9]")
			(regex #"/dev/bpf([0-9])+")
		)
		(require-any
			(signing-identifier "com.apple.mDNSResponderHelper")
			(signing-identifier "com.apple.wapic")
		)
	)
)
